verdict.rationale: Wave's first-party docs cover every element of the story: creating unlimited, customizable invoices; online payment through a "Pay now" button (credit card, ACH/EFT, Apple Pay); and status tracking for when an invoice is viewed, becomes due, or gets paid. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the view/paid tracking and payment flow, since all evidence is vendor marketing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Create unlimited estimates, invoices, bills, and bookkeeping records
Customers can click a “Pay now” button on invoices and pay instantly by credit card or secure bank payment (ACH/EFT)
Know when an invoice is viewed, becomes due, or gets paid, so you can take the right actions to manage your cash flow.
Get paid fast via credit card, bank payment, or Apple Pay
